editorial:
Imagine starting your adult life with a giant lie that you just cannot escape. That is exactly the mess you get into with the main character here. He is just a regular guy working a private job, but because of some crazy circumstances and a few white lies, everyone suddenly believes he is some kind of genius or expert. The vibe is lighthearted and silly, as he somehow ends up being called upon by government agencies to solve massive national problems like the housing crisis and unemployment. It is a classic case of fake it till you make it, and watching him sweat while trying to keep the act going is where the real fun is.

You will love how the movie pokes fun at bureaucracy and how people believe almost anything if you sound confident enough. The acting is great, and the comedy hits most of the time, though some parts feel a bit slow. If you enjoy stories about ordinary people in over their heads, you should definitely check this out. It is a perfect movie for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up when the main character's web of lies finally catches up to him. After being treated like a hero for solving public crises, the truth comes out in a big, chaotic way. However, instead of everything falling apart, his accidental success actually brings about some real changes. He finds a way to reconcile his fake persona with his real self, and the story ends with a funny lesson about honesty and luck.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves comedies about mistaken identity and social satire.
